info.title: AION Autonomous Agentic Commerce & PayPal API

get.summary: Get PayPal Sandbox Connection Status and Ledger
get.description: Returns verified OAuth connection status, settlement wallet balance, and recent transaction records.

200.description: PayPal status and ledger retrieved successfully.

post.summary: Create Order, Capture, or Execute Autonomous Agentic Payout
post.description: Supports action types: 'create-order' (Orders v2), 'capture-order', or 'agentic-payout' (Payouts v1 guarded by UNWIND).
Handles PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED, PAYMENT.PAYOUTSBATCH.SUCCESS and records immutable proof into the AG Grid ledger.
